data.title: La Mer by ELIE SAAB
data.about:
La Mer by ELIE SAAB is a landmark of refined elegance nestled on the pristine shores of Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah. Comprising three architecturally distinct towers, this branded residential development redefines coastal luxury with panoramic vistas of the Arabian Gulf, curated interiors by ELIE SAAB Maison, and timeless design sensibilities. Every element, from the exterior façade to the finest interior detail, reflects Elie Saab’s signature aesthetic—harmonizing modern opulence with serene waterfront living.

Residents of La Mer will enjoy a collection of exquisitely designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive chalets, each crafted to evoke comfort, sophistication, and a bespoke lifestyle. With access to world-class amenities including sky pools, serenity parks, signature lounges, and wellness-focused facilities, La Mer offers more than a residence—it promises an immersive living experience where art, design, and tranquility converge on one of the UAE’s most coveted island destinations.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy Breathtaking Sea Views at La Mer at Al Marjan Island
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Branded Residences: Designed and furnished by ELIE SAAB Maison
  • Prime Island Location: Situated on the iconic Al Marjan Island in RAK
  • Breathtaking Views: Overlooks the Arabian Gulf with uninterrupted sea vistas
  • Signature Interiors: Elegantly curated spaces with bespoke detailing
  • Sky Amenities: Sky pool, sky gym, and co-working lounge with panoramic views
  • Wellness & Leisure: Spa, serenity park, kids club, and grand swimming pools
  • Spacious Layouts: 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and exclusive chalets.
  • Resort-Style Living: Direct beach access with a luxury lifestyle community
  • ELIE SAAB Touch: Every detail reflects the brand’s signature sophistication

location_tile.title: Al Marjan Island: The Pinnacle of Waterfront Living
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Al Marjan Island is Ras Al Khaimah’s crown jewel—a man-made archipelago that stretches gracefully into the Arabian Gulf, offering a sanctuary of luxury, tranquility, and seaside splendor. With its pristine beaches, crystal-clear waters, and thoughtfully planned infrastructure, the island is fast emerging as a premier lifestyle and investment destination in the UAE. Al Marjan’s strategic location places it just 45 minutes from Dubai, making it a seamless escape from the city's pace while staying effortlessly connected to its vibrancy.

This idyllic setting makes La Mer by ELIE SAAB not just a home, but a statement of refined living on one of the most exclusive coastal destinations in the region. The island is poised for exponential growth, with major developments including luxury resorts, waterfront retail, and entertainment hubs on the horizon. Residents at La Mer will enjoy the serenity of island life with all the benefits of a rising world-class destination—making it the perfect blend of exclusivity, comfort, and long-term value.

  • 2 minutes to DoubleTree by Hilton Resort & Spa​
  • 3 minutes to InterContinental Mina Al Arab​
  • 4 minutes to Rixos Bab Al Bahr​
  • 5 minutes to Al Hamra Mall​
  • 7 minutes to Al Hamra Golf Club​
  • 10 minutes to Wynn Al Marjan Island (Upcoming Casino Resort)​
  • 12 minutes to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Salem Road​
  • 15 minutes to Ras Al Khaimah City Center
